concerns.text: The specification redefines the research question from aggregating *published upper bounds* (as stated in the Idea) to aggregating *point estimates* of D‑coefficients with uncertainties and performing weighted‑mean meta‑analysis (see FR‑001, FR‑002). This constitutes a silent scope drift: the original goal of combining one‑sided limits to obtain a collective sensitivity floor is replaced by a different statistical problem, violating the core premise of the Idea.

The spec adds a “Sensitivity Analysis that sweeps the heterogeneity threshold” (FR‑011) and a full Feasibility Report comparing to the original “fusion of raw spectra” method, neither of which were requested in the Idea. These are unnecessary extensions that constitute over‑reach beyond the stated research question.
